The passage says: Atu027[2], TKM-080301[3], DCR-MYC[4], NBF-006[5], and EphA2 siRNA[6]. This matches the carrier column of the table, where Atu027 is listed with liposomes, TKM-080301, DCR-MYC and NBF-006 with LNPs, and EphA2 siRNA with DOPC.
